fit.title: Scenario DCF
fit.reason: Future scale, margins and reinvestment drive the outcome. Compare downside, base and upside cash-flow paths; use revenue or earnings multiples only where economically meaningful.
fit.caution: Forecast uncertainty is high. A precise model output does not establish a precise fair value.
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.

warnings: Financial statements may use a different reporting currency from the listing. Values with unmatched currency are withheld.
Stockholders/owners equity is not automatically treated as common equity. Preferred and AT1 capital require a verified adjustment.
